decided.note: maybe view is enough for this? kind of hard to see how it will look in pr view
decided.why: Kept — and the note names exactly why the view is needed. CodeCell is the paint unit the find and occurrence math key on, so its isolated cells are the contract; 'hard to see how it will look in the PR view' is an argument for extracting the review screen, which is the next view, not for dropping these cells.
